status: GB poor rates, partial French local taxes and US state-government benchmark added to local draft.

england_wales.coverage: England and Wales poor rates only. Combined with Scottish assessments for the GB comparison. County payments financed from poor rates must not be added twice.

france.coverage: Partial nearby-year comparison: net 1823 octrois plus selected 1826 local surtaxes. Not a complete 1822 local-tax total. Fixed departmental centimes are not separately added. Some departmental taxes appear in central accounts; do not assume central and local rows are additive.
france.reference: A. Legoyt, Les octrois en France, Journal de la Societe statistique de Paris 10 (1869), pp. 175-176.
france.surtax_reference: Moureau, Des centimes additionnels, Gazette des tribunaux, 22 April 1829, PDF p.3, reproducing final 1826 direct-tax accounts.
france.verification: Table checked against page image. Cadastral figure is 3,612,950, not OCR 3,612,250; all eight account lines sum to printed total 341,860,014.
france.gdp_source: Andersson and Brambor, Financing the State v3.0, France 1822 gdpnom=9045 million francs.

new_york.coverage: Reported Treasury receipts. Not yet reconciled to ordinary revenue excluding loans, fund transfers and capital transactions, or to separate canal accounts. No verified 1822 state income/GDP denominator found.
new_york.reference: Governor Joseph C. Yates, annual message, 7 January 1823, printed p. 10.
new_york.research_lead: Sowers, Financial History of New York State (1914); also Sylla, Legler and Wallis (1987), Banks and State Public Finance in the New Republic, which uses ordinary revenues net of borrowing but notes uneven special-fund coverage.

scotland.treatment: Unscaled proxy for 1822; excludes voluntary contributions and other local taxes

great_britain.gdp_source: Bank of England A millennium of macroeconomic data v3.1, A9. Nominal GDP (A), H140

us_states_1820.coverage: US state governments collectively; includes non-tax receipts; excludes federal and municipal revenue. Nearby-year benchmark, not a reconstructed 1822 observation.
us_states_1820.revenue_source: John Joseph Wallis (2000), American Government Finance in the Long Run: 1790 to 1990, Journal of Economic Perspectives 14(1), table 1 p65.
us_states_1820.gdp_source: Andersson and Brambor, Financing the State v3.0; United States 1820 gdpnom=703 million USD. Numerator and denominator both 1820.
us_states_1820.precision: Revenue total is calculated from rounded per-capita estimate; not an exact account total.
